what: r4subdata: Example Datasets for Clinical Submission Readiness — r4subdata-package
title: r4subdata: Example Datasets for Clinical Submission Readiness — r4subdata-package
text: Provides realistic synthetic example datasets R4SUB (R Regulatory Submission) ecosystem. Includes pharma study evidence table, ADaM (Analysis Data Model) SDTM (Study Data Tabulation Model) metadata following CDISC (Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium) conventions (https://www.cdisc.org), traceability mappings, risk register based ICH (International Council Harmonisation) Q9 quality risk management principles (https://www.ich.org/page/quality-guidelines), regulatory indicator definitions. Designed demos, vignettes, package testing.
